scripts.postbuild: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; fs.cpSync('app', 'dist/app', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('vendor', 'dist/vendor', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('cron', 'dist/cron', { recursive: true }); try { fs.unlinkSync('dist/.env'); console.log('REMOVED dist/.env (must NOT ship in dist)'); } catch {} console.log('Copied app/, vendor/ and cron/ to dist/. .env must live outside public_html on the server.');"
scripts.audit:all: npm run check && npm run test:php && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:seo
